title: よ (emphasis / new information)
meaning: Sentence-final particle: tells the listener something they do not know, gives emphasis or reassurance.
simpleExplanation: よ at the end of a sentence tells the listener something they do not know yet, or adds a friendly push: この店は安いですよ "This shop is cheap, you know". Think of it as "I'm telling you". It is used when YOU have the information and the listener does not. If you both already know, use ね instead.
whenUsed: Giving new information, reassuring someone (大丈夫ですよ), warning (危ないですよ), correcting a wrong idea, and answering questions with a little emphasis.
formation: Polite sentence + よ  (〜ですよ ／ 〜ますよ)

examples.reading: この みせは やすいですよ。
examples.en: This shop is cheap, you know.
examples.note: Sharing information the listener doesn't have.

examples.reading: もう はちじですよ。
examples.note: A warning: the listener has not noticed the time.

examples.ja: A：田中さんはどこですか。　B：もう帰りましたよ。
examples.reading: たなかさんは どこですか。　もう かえりましたよ。
examples.en: Where is Mr Tanaka? — He already went home, you know.
examples.note: B gives A information A did not have.

examples.ja: あ、財布が落ちましたよ。
examples.reading: あ、さいふが おちましたよ。
examples.note: Telling someone something they have not noticed.

similarGrammar.difference: ね checks shared knowledge or asks for agreement; よ delivers new information.

commonMistakes.wrong: （looking at the sky together）いい天気ですよ。
commonMistakes.why: Both people can see the weather, so it is shared knowledge: ね, not よ.

commonMistakes.wrong: 私は学生ですよ。（in a neutral self-introduction）
commonMistakes.why: よ in a neutral statement sounds pushy. Use it only when the information matters to the listener.
よ is a sentence-final particle; it can only sit at the end.

usageNotes: Overusing よ sounds pushy. Do not use よ when the listener already knows the information — use ね instead.
jlptTips: In a two-line dialogue, the line that answers a question or corrects the other person ends in よ; the line that agrees ends in ね.
A warning or a reassurance (危ない, 大丈夫, もう〜時) followed by a blank is almost always よ.
